description: This file contains functions for configuring and managing DHCP protocol interactions in a network setup, including initialization, setup, renewal, and teardown procedures used by the netifd system in OpenWRT.

methods.name: proto_dhcp_add_sendopts
methods.description: Adds DHCP send options parameter to the DHCP options list.

methods.name: proto_dhcp_setup
methods.description: Sets up the DHCP client with specified configuration, starts the udhcpc process.

methods.name: proto_dhcp_renew
methods.description: Forces DHCP lease renewal by sending SIGUSR1 to udhcpc process.

methods.name: proto_dhcp_teardown
methods.description: Terminates the DHCP process associated with the interface.
